mapper.insert: INSERT INTO raw_record ( source_id, run_id, external_record_id, source_url, fetched_at, payload_hash, parser_version, parse_status, payload, payload_expires_at, first_seen_at, last_seen_at ) VALUES ( #{sourceId}, #{runId}, #{externalRecordId}, #{sourceUrl}, #{fetchedAt}, #{payloadHash}, #{parserVersion}, 'PENDING', #{payload}, #{payloadExpiresAt}, #{now}, #{now} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id), source_url = VALUES(source_url), fetched_at = VALUES(fetched_at), payload_hash = VALUES(payload_hash), parser_version = VALUES(parser_version), parse_status = 'PENDING', payload = VALUES(payload), payload_expires_at = VALUES(payload_expires_at), last_seen_at = VALUES(last_seen_at)
mapper.select: SELECT f.id AS failure_id, ds.source_type, r.external_record_id, r.source_url, CAST(r.payload AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4) AS payload, r.fetched_at FROM crawl_failure f JOIN raw_record r ON r.id = f.raw_record_id JOIN data_source ds ON ds.id = r.source_id WHERE f.run_id = #{runId} AND f.retryable = TRUE AND f.resolved = FALSE AND f.attempt_count < 5 AND r.payload IS NOT NULL ORDER BY f.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE crawl_failure SET attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, resolved = #{resolved}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{failureId} AND retryable = TRUE AND resolved = FALSE AND attempt_count < 5

UPDATE raw_record SET payload = NULL, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id IN ( SELECT candidate.id FROM ( SELECT id FROM raw_record WHERE payload IS NOT NULL AND payload_expires_at <= #{expiredBefore} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{batchSize} ) candidate )
UPDATE raw_record SET parse_status = 'PARSED' WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE raw_record SET parse_status = 'FAILED' WHERE id = #{id}

INSERT INTO quality_metric_snapshot ( source_id, task_id, run_id, metric_code, numerator, denominator, metric_value, measured_at ) SELECT task.source_id, run.task_id, run.id, #{metricCode}, #{numerator}, #{denominator}, CASE WHEN #{denominator} = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(#{numerator} AS DECIMAL(20, 6)) / #{denominator} END, #{measuredAt} FROM crawl_run run JOIN crawl_task task ON task.id = run.task_id WHERE run.id = #{runId} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE numerator = numerator + VALUES(numerator), denominator = denominator + VALUES(denominator), metric_value = CASE WHEN denominator = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(numerator AS DECIMAL(20, 6)) / denominator END, measured_at = VALUES(measured_at), version = quality_metric_snapshot.version + 1
